notes.title: Arkero Socials' Update
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hello players![/b][/h2]
We're excited to announce two new ways for you to connect with the Arkero VR universe and fellow players:

[h3][u][b]Reddit:[/b][/u][/h3] Dive into discussions, share your experiences, and stay updated with the latest news on our official subreddit: 
[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/ArkeroVR/?rdt=50982]r/ArkeroVR[/url].​

[h3][u][b]Discord:[/b][/u][/h3] Engage in real-time conversations, participate in community events, and collaborate with other players on our Discord server: 
[url=https://discord.gg/MaaMWj2Qza]Join Here[/url].​

Whether you're seeking gameplay tips, eager to share your adventures, or just want to be part of the Arkero VR community, these platforms are the perfect place to start.​
We look forward to seeing you there!

 - Arkero Team
